thread:
anna: FYI - MediPulse just moved to contract review. They want a predictable monthly bill + a small burst bucket for unexpected spikes. Also strict EU PHI residency for production.
jay: Requesting traffic slice: whats baseline qps and burst profile?
anna: Baseline 300 qps, daily peak spikes to 1.2-1.5k qps for 5-15m, mostly long chat gen + occasional 4k-token embeddings for analytics.
theo: For long contexts 4k tokens, throughput drops. Recommend conservative reserved commit = 6 x A100-class GPUs (quantized path). That gives ~720 qps sustained w/ our batching assumptions. Add a 4-node burst pool (on-demand) to cover peaks if preheated.
rachel: Curious on KV warm start cost. How long to preheat for a known daily window?
theo: KV prewarm depends on shared prefix patterns; plan on 20-40 minutes of scheduled preheat to reach stable p95. If they can provide an hour window even better.
anna: They asked if burst credits can be reusable month-to-month or expire.
jay: We usually offer two flavors: prepaid monthly credits that roll over up to 30 days, or one-off ad-hoc burst purchases. For enterprise commits we can include a small rollover pool (up to X% of commit).
rachel: Legal wants the wording: "burst credits will be region-scoped and cannot be used across EU/US partitions." Ops confirm?
theo: Confirmed. Burst pool bound to region where credits purchased. EU-only residency enforces region-bound scheduling.
ops-bot: infra-alert: regional-pool-eu capacity check passed (sufficient headroom: 25% free).
jay: Pricing scenario idea: Option 1: 6 reserved GPUs + 20% monthly rollover burst credits. Option 2: 8 reserved GPUs (no burst credits) for SLA-backed p95. Option 3: Private EU deploy for strict compliance + custom retention.
anna: Requesting quick TCO delta between 6 vs 8 reserved - ballpark numbers ok for quote.
jay: Rough math: adding 2 GPUs ~= +33% commit cost (depends on SKU). Burst credits cost = ~10% of 1 GPU equivalent per 100% credit pool used. I'll run finance calc.
theo: Also call out performance SLAs: with 8 reserved we can commit p95 token latency <= 220ms for quantized path at steady-state. With 6 reserved + burst credits SLA only covers reserved baseline; preheated bursts can be SLA-backed if customer agrees to scheduled preheat windows.
rachel: Security Qs: they want KMS control and 12-month audit logs. Can we provide customer-managed key + long retention?
ops-bot: note: hosted-default logs = 90d. Enterprise/private deploy supports 12mo retention + export to customer S3. C MK support available in private.
anna: MediPulse also asked about autoscale behavior when burst nodes fail during peak. What's graceful degradation?
theo: Autoscale policy should include queue throttling, fallback model, and circuit-breaker. Example policy to share:

```json
{
  "scale_target": "reserved_pool",
  "min_gpus": 6,
  "max_gpus": 10,
  "scale_up_qps": 600,
  "scale_down_qps": 350,
  "preheat_minutes": 30,
  "fallback": "quantized-v2-medium",
  "circuit_breaker_queue": 2000
}
```

theo: Behavior: if burst nodes unavailable, route excess to fallback model with degraded quality but preserved latency; block new sessions if queue > circuit_breaker_queue and notify customer.
jay: They asked for p99 latency expectations. Provide synthetic sim numbers and caveat re: cold KV.
anna: Can someone run a sim for quantized-v2-large at 4k context and produce p50/p95/p99 token latencies and throughput? Need for the RFP.
theo: I'll queue a sim and attach results - ETA 36h. Will include cold and warm KV runs.
rachel: Contract clause draft: "All PHI and customer data for the EU residency option will be processed and stored exclusively within EU-managed infrastructure. Any automatic cross-region failover will be executed only with Customer's prior written consent and must use data-masking if enabled by the Customer."
jay: small typo: change "Customers" to "Customer's".
anna: Action items: theo runs sim (36h), jay to pull ballpark pricing delta (24h), rachel to draft security answers + clause (48h). I'll consolidate and send to MediPulse by EOD +3.
ops-bot: sim-run-4150 queued; results will land at s3://redwood-poc-results/medipulse/4150000000/ once complete.
anna: Thanks team. Keep replies tight so I can forward as-is to procurement. :white_check_mark:
